title: radio.py: collision epoch never closes without a <2-candidate poll
description:
## Problem

9098.29 added _collision_open so an evolving overlap frozenset is one event. The epoch is closed only inside _get_rx_result_internal when resolve_reception is None and len(candidates) < 2, or on receiver teardown (_drop_chaos_state_for_receiver).

RadioMixin._handle_tx_end / _drop_chaos_state_for_tx do not discard the receiver from _collision_open. advance_to / process_next_event never poll.

Sequence:

1. Poll during {A,B} -> record_collision, open_ids.add(rx).
2. advance_to past both TxEndEvents with no get_rx_result / deliver_pending_packets in between. Medium is empty; epoch still open.
3. New disjoint overlap {C,D}. First poll hits node_id in open_ids and pass. metrics.collisions stays 1.

HIL 1 ms loop usually inserts a 0-candidate poll after TxEnd and hides this. Unit tests and BARRIER_SYNC drivers that advance_to between bursts do not. test_staggered_overlap_counts_one_collision only grows one set; it never ends the overlap and starts another.

Same hole on the other side: a collision observed once, then no poll until a later unrelated pair, under-counts collision_rate for capacity / A/B oracles.

This is not 9098.29 (frozenset snapshot inflation). The epoch flag has no timeout and is not tied to the tx_id set that opened it.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py (_collision_open_set, collision arm, _handle_tx_end)
- python/src/lichen/sim/metrics.py (collision_rate)
- python/tests/sim/test_radio.py (test_staggered_overlap_counts_one_collision)
close_reason: Collision epochs store participating tx ids and close on TxEnd, so a later disjoint overlap is counted without an empty-candidate poll.
